name: Kod Belyh Lilij
source:
A common technician guy inspects a station that's rarely used. Suddenly he finds an unknown girl there. Turned out that she's a representative of extinguished civilization. Her homeland was destroyed by the Black Empire. It would seem she was saved as she'd reached the Earth. But it isn't so. The Black Empire is already here secretly. Its soldiers fight people unseen. The protagonist is actively involved in turning events. He's trying to settle some issues.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2682690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名普通技术员到一座鲜少启用的站点检查，意外在那里发现了一个陌生女孩。原来，她来自一个已经灭亡的文明，故乡被黑色帝国摧毁了。她既然逃到了地球，看起来总该安全了。可惜并非如此：黑色帝国早已秘密抵达这里，士兵们正在人们看不见的地方与人类交战。局势风云变幻，主人公也投身其中，试着解决摆在面前的问题。

〔摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2682690/]Steam[/url]〕
